ModMetaData.name: RimStats
ModMetaData.author: Progme
ModMetaData.description:
A high-performance data analytics framework for RimWorld.
RimStats automatically tracks colony metrics, pawn lifespans, and economic trends, storing them in a local SQLite database for external analysis.
Key Features: - Real-time event logging (Deaths, Raids, Harvests). - Detailed pawn demographics tracking. - Automated data export to /Analytics/db/rimstats.db. - Designed for integration with external Python-based dashboards.
